Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Pakistan players are out in the middle. Janneman Malan and Aiden Markram will open the innings for South Africa. Shaheen Afridi will start the proceedings for Pakistan.

So South Africa need 321 to win the series. Their relatively inexperienced batting lineup will need to be at their best if they are to scale this target. Pakistan will feel they have momentum and the batters have managed to do their job. The onus now will be on their bowlers to defend this. Will South Africa manage to chase this down or will Pakistan seal the ODI series? Join us for the chase to find out.

Aiden Markram is down for an interview. He says that he is happy with the bowling effort of the team. Adds that the openers need to get a solid start to chase this total. Mentions that there is little bit of rain but it can help them in chasing. Further says that the first 10 overs would be crucial and they need a solid foundation. Ends by saying that they should not lose wickets in the first 10 overs.

A good comeback from South Africa but they threw it away in the final 3 overs of the innings. They did not start off well as they struggled for wickets. They were struggling but managed to pull things back with their spinners from overs 35 to 47. They had Pakistan in a situation where 300 looked difficult but 63 runs in the final 4 overs changed the tide of the game. Keshav Maharaj was the star with the ball, finishing with 3/45 from his 10. Aiden Markram impressed as well finishing with 2/48. Smuts was instrumental in South Africa pulling things back but he was taken to the cleaners by Hasan Ali in his final over. Phehlukwayo was the other bowler with a wicket but was expensive too. Sipamla, Dupavillon, and Hendricks failed to get any success but the latter went for less than 6 rpo.

After being put into bat, Pakistan got off to a solid start as the opening pair of Imam and Fakhar added 112. The former departed after getting to his fifty but Fakhar continued from where he left off in the last game. He stitched a superb 94-run stand with Babar and scored another ton. At 206/1 it looked like 330 was well on the cards but it is Pakistan, always expect the unexpected. The fall of Fakhar post his ton saw a collapse from the batting order. The middle-order fell like nine pins and they found themselves stuttering at 257/6. It looked like 300 was now farfetched but once again expect the unexpected from Pakistan. A blistering partnership 63-run stand off just 24 balls between Babar and Hasan Ali dragged the game back in the visitors' side as they managed to get to 320, with Babar finishing with a magnificent 94!

What a finish from Pakistan! They looked like they would struggle to get to 300 but 56 runs in the final 3 overs changed the momentum completely and has seen Pakistan finish with a total of 320. South Africa will be gutted with how they finished the innings after making a solid comeback before the 4 overs.

Play and a miss! Dot to finish Powerplay 1! A decent one for Pakistan. They have not scored runs at a quick succession but have not lost a wicket. Length ball outside off, Fakhar looks to slash it through the off side but misses.
Slightly behind the good length area outside off. Imam runs it down to short third man for one.
Good length ball on off, Imam pushes it to mid on.
On the pads, Zaman flicks it to square leg for one.

Just a single off the Free Hit. Bouncer outside off from Beuran Hendricks. Imam pulls it but does not get enough on it. The catch is taken at deep mid-wicket. Single taken as one cannot be out on a Free Hit ball.

NO BALL! Now smartly follows the boundary with a single. Length delivery coming in with the angle on the pads. Fakhar turns it to the on side for one. The T.V. umpire later sees that Beuran Hendricks has overstepped. FREE HIT coming up for Imam.
FOUR! Fakhar has decided to spread his wings now. That is just hammered. Fullish ball outside off, Fakhar picks the length early and hits across the line over mid on for a boundary.
Full on middle, Imam flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full on off, Imam pushes it to covers.
Short delivery on middle, Zaman pulls it through square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Imam flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, Zaman flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Zaman pushes it to covers.
Length delivery on middle, Imam flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short delivery on off, Imam punches it to point.
Full ball on off, Zaman drives it towards mid off for a single.
Length delivery on off, Zaman defends it off the back foot.

EDGED AND FOUR! First one for Fakhar and it is a lucky one. Good ball from Beuran. He goes slightly fuller around off, tempting Fakhar to go for the drive. Fakhar falls in the honey trap and goes for the drive. The ball shapes away and catches the outside edge of Zaman's willow. Luckily for him, it goes wide of the man at slip and away from third man for a boundary.
PLAY AND A MISS! Short delivery outside off, Zaman looks to pull but misses it.
Back of a length on off, Imam-ul-Haq pushes it to covers.
Short of a length on middle, Zaman pulls it towards fine leg for a run.
Full delivery on middle, Imam flicks it towards mid on for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Imam keeps it out.

TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Imam continues to ride his luck. Good length delivery on the body. Imam looks to pull but the ball is not short enough for him to go for that. He still goes with the shot. The ball takes the top edge and goes away from third man and bounces just inside the ropes for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Imam pushes it to mid off.

In the air but in no man's land! Beuran hits the back of a length area around off. The ball raises a bit onto Imam. He has struggled against the short ball. He looks to pull but gets a top edge. Luckily for Imam it goes over the slip and away from the third man fielder.
Length delivery on middle, Imam defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Imam pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Imam looks to defend but misses it.
Length delivery on middle, Zaman pushes it towards mid on and takes a quick single.
WIDE! Hendricks bowls it wide outside off, Zaman offers no shot to this one.
Good length delivery outside off, Zaman looks to defend but gets hit on the thigh pad.
On a length on middle, Imam flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Length delivery on middle, Imam flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get a couple.
Full ball outside off, Imam drives it through covers. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it. Two runs taken.
Full delivery on off, Imam-ul-Haq drives it to covers.
Good length delivery on middle, Imam looks to defend but gets an inside edge. It goes to square leg.
Full delivery on middle, Imam flicks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Imam looks to flick but misses it.
First bowling change of the game and it sees Lutho Sipamla replace Aiden Markram.
Length ball on middle and leg, Imam flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Imam pushes it to covers.
Length delivery on middle, Imam flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Imam pushes it to point.

FOUR! First boundary of the game and it comes from the bat of Imam! He has been found wanting against the short ball in the past but this time he plays it well. Short ball around off, Imam pulls it in front of square on the leg side. The outfield is relatively slow but Imam gets enough on it to send it to the fence.
Good length ball on off, Imam defends it off the back foot.
WIDE! Length delivery down the leg side, Imam looks to flick but misses it. It is wided by the umpire.
Floated ball on off, Zaman pushes it to covers.
On off, Zaman defends it off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on off, Zaman pushes it back towards the bowler.
Flighted ball on middle, Imam looks to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat. It goes to square leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Full delivery on off, Zaman pushes it through mid off for a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Imam flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Just a run from the second over as well. The last ball is on a length on off. Fakhar defends it.
Length ball outside off. No movement on this one. Fakhar leaves it alone.
Another good ball! This one is bowled at 132 kph but it skids off the deck. It is around the pads, Fakhar looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad.
Good length delivery on the pads, Fakhar looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Good length delivery pitching outside off. There is a little movement for Beuran. Fakhar though leaves it alone and is happy to watch it carry to the keeper.
Beuran Hendricks starts with a full ball around the pads of Imam. He places it to the left of mid off and takes a quick single.
Who will bowl from the other end with the other new ball? It will be Beuran Hendricks!
Dot to finish the first over. A tidy and tight one. The last ball is darted very full on the leg pole. Fakhar jams it out.
Imam and Pakistan are off the mark. Short on middle, Imam turns it to the leg side and gets a single.
Very good start to the first over so far. It is another dot. Flighted delivery on the stumps, Imam keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on off, Imam defends it.
Short now from Markram and it is on middle. No room for Imam, and he blocks it off his back foot.
Markram starts right on the money. Bowls a loopy delivery on off, Imam starts his innings with a push to cover.

We are all set for the action to begin! The South African players are in a huddle, with their skipper having a final word of motivation for his troops before they take their respective positions in the field. The star from the last game, Fakhar Zaman walks out with Imam-ul-Haq to open the innings for Pakistan.  Who will start the proceedings with the new ball for South Africa? It will be spin and surprise, surprise. It is going to be Aiden Markram!

South Africa Playing XI - Aiden Markram, Janneman Malan, JJ Smuts, Temba Bavuma (C), Kyle Verreynne, Heinrich Klaasen (WK), Andile Phehlukwayo, Keshav Maharaj, Daryn Dupavillon, Beuran Hendricks, Lutho Sipamla.
Pakistan Playing XI - Imam-ul-Haq, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan, Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK), Mohammad Nawaz, Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Usman Qadir, Haris Rauf.
TOSS - The coin has come down in favour of Temba Bavuma. SOUTH AFRICA OPT TO BOWL!
NEWS - Big blow for South Africa as Rassie van der Dussen is out of this game after suffering a Grade One left quadriceps muscle strain.

Hello and welcome to the 3rd and final ODI between South Africa and Pakistan. It has been a closely fought series so far and both sides will be eager to win the decider. South Africa will miss a few of their stars but they would hope the players coming on for them can fill that void. Pakistan, on the other hand, will look to punish this slightly weakened Proteas side. Will Bavuma win his first series as a captain or will Babar and co. ruin it? Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
